dataset: VeReMi (original; LuST + modified Veins; 225 simulations = 5 attackers x 3 attacker fractions x 3 densities x 5 repetitions)

title: A Unifying Review of Deep and Shallow Anomaly Detection
authors: Lukas Ruff, Jacob R. Kauffmann, Robert A. Vandermeulen, Grégoire Montavon, Wojciech Samek, Marius Kloft, Thomas G. Dietterich, Klaus-Robert Müller
venue: Proceedings of the IEEE, vol. 109, no. 5, pp. 756-795
key_claim: Unifies density, one-class and reconstruction-based AD.
